articles.summary: Loop Industries today announced that its India joint-venture ELITe, formed in partnership with Ester Industries, has awarded the detailed engineering contract for its Infinite Loop™ India project to Toyo Engineering India Private Limited, a globally recognized EPC firm with over four decades of experience executing large-scale industrial and petrochemical projects across India.
articles.title: Loop Industries and Ester Industries’ India Joint Venture Awards Detailed Engineering Contract to Toyo for Infinite Loop™ India
